description:
Relocation stub. Published up to 0.2.0 as the single PostgreSQL
        EntityLocker; since 0.3.0 that adapter is named
        event-outboxer-lock-postgres-advisory, alongside the new
        event-outboxer-lock-postgres-lease (the PostgreSQL default, ADR-0022).
        Carries no code — it only redirects Maven to the advisory
        adapter.
